#

# __Mathieu Maheu-Giroux, ScD__
### Assistant Professor, McGill University
I am an interdisciplinary public health researcher and my research has focused primarily on 1) infectious disease modeling, 2) epidemiology and measurements, and 3) impact evaluations of public health interventions. 

As of 2017, I have joined the Department of Epidemiology and Biostatistics at [McGill Univeristy](https://www.mcgill.ca/epi-biostat-occh/). Prior to this appointment, I was a sponsored researcher in the Department of Infectious Disease Epidemiology at [Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/school-public-health/infectious-disease-epidemiology/). I completed my doctoral traning in population health, quantitative methods, and impact evaluation at the [Harvard TH Chan School of Public Health](https://www.hsph.harvard.edu/global-health-and-population/). My research program is funded by a FRQS Junior 1 Research Scholar Award.
